scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core apps/api apps/worker && pnpm --filter @posta/web typecheck && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm typecheck:scripts
scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter @posta/core run build && pnpm --filter @posta/core run migrate
scripts.migrate:status: pnpm --filter @posta/core run build && pnpm --filter @posta/core run migrate:status
scripts.migrate:down: pnpm --filter @posta/core run build && pnpm --filter @posta/core run migrate:down
scripts.seed: pnpm --filter @posta/core run build && pnpm --filter @posta/core run seed
scripts.seed:asn: pnpm --filter @posta/core run build && pnpm --filter @posta/core run seed:asn
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio && docker compose up -d minio-init && docker compose wait minio-init && turbo run dev
